title: Gate feature-flagged panel options at render/use site, not just in the options pane
answers: Panel still uses per-row rendering/pagination or shows the frame selector after the text.newFeatures flag is turned off
A saved panel keeps a pre-GA behavior even though the option is hidden in the editor
How to properly gate a new panel option behind a feature flag
body:
Symptom: a panel saved while a feature flag was on keeps using the gated behavior (per-row render mode, frame selection, pagination) even after the flag is turned off, because the flag was only checked when deciding what to show/offer in the options pane.
Root cause: public/app/plugins/panel/text/v2/module.tsx's showForData/useFieldConfig gating only controlled editor visibility; public/app/plugins/panel/text/v2/TextNGPanel.tsx read options.renderMode/options.frameIndex directly, and saved panel JSON persists those fields independent of current flag state.
Fix pattern: compute the flag once per render (e.g. `const newFeatures = isTextNewFeaturesEnabled()`), derive a gated local value (`renderMode = newFeatures ? options.renderMode : RenderMode.Once`, `currentFrameIndex = newFeatures ? getCurrentFrameIndex(...) : 0`), and thread that gated value everywhere downstream (series slicing, pagination, templateOf, renderPanelContent) instead of the raw option.
Constraints: applies to any pre-GA option stored in panel JSON and controlled by a feature flag; once the feature is GA and the flag removed, the gating and fallback branch should be deleted.
